Proposal under D01: 60 active s of own-file review and answer drafting with teammate and AI channels closed, then the check-in (outside active time), then 300 active s with all channels (spec §4.1).
Scripted requests at interaction seconds 20/120/210 = active 80/180/270 remain a proposal until D01; they are not values from S4.
All response classes use the concurrent mechanism (spec §6.5); distributions reuse the reference parameters pending D10.
Request seats: majority seat drawn by a fair coin (not always JT) so request sender stays balanced against the rating seat (spec §7.1 invariant 7); proposal under D07.
Re-issued as tp_review_first_v4 to bind consent.reference@v3 (Appendix B verbatim: '#XXXX-XXXX' transcription fix, BA-37); content otherwise identical to tp_review_first_v3.

UX round 3 item 5 (revised 2026-10-07, BA-97): the own time-pressure rating is skippable — consent states skipping questions does not affect payment; the server accepts pressure_skip. An unanswered check-in still times out to technical_stop, which keeps base pay under D04.
FR-1 feature flag: structured requests plus natural language (the pre-round-3 behavior).

2026-10-15 crate-overlap experiment: some crate-overlap condition — 8 crates, each teammate assigned four with partial assignment overlap. Live fielding is gated by the CRATE_OVERLAP_ENABLED deployment flag.

Thin-file variant (CRATE_NUMBER_ENABLED): the participant's case file is trimmed to participant_intel_budget records — 4 most-recent records per assigned crate plus 4 single records on teammate crates. Fielding needs both CRATE_OVERLAP_ENABLED and CRATE_NUMBER_ENABLED.
